entities.name: Fabric of All Being
entities.description: Ancient artifact from the Edge, predating the Fomori-Eldrazi war, holding the fates of all things and kept by the Drix.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Species that possesses the Fabric of All Being on a hidden beam world.

entities.name: Fomori-Eldrazi war
entities.description: Ancient war that the Fabric of All Being predates.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Alliance the Drix guided in developing eternity columns and drives.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose return the Drix try to prevent.

events.summary: The Fabric of All Being helped the Drix unlock weftwalking, some of which they shared with Pinnacle.
events.quote: was instrumental in unlocking the knowledge of weftwalking for the Drix

events.summary: The Drix use the Fabric to identify and assassinate critical potential Eldrazi beings.
events.quote: The artifact is used by the Drix to identify and assassinate critical potential Eldrazi beings
